name: Mirror
teaser: Generic perfect mirror built from any closed shape.

name: SquarePlanoMirror2D
teaser: Flat square mirror for 2D ray tracing.

name: SquarePlanoMirror
teaser: Flat square mirror with a substrate thickness.

name: RectangularPlanoMirror
teaser: Flat rectangular mirror with a substrate thickness.

name: RoundPlanoMirror
teaser: Round flat mirror with a substrate thickness.

name: SphericalMirror
teaser: Concave spherical mirror for non-dispersive focusing.

name: RightAnglePrismMirror
teaser: 90 degree beam-turning prism mirror.

name: ConicMirror
teaser: On-axis mirror with an arbitrary conic constant.

name: OffAxisConicMirror
teaser: Off-axis segment of a conic mirror.

name: ParabolicMirror
teaser: On-axis parabolic mirror, free of spherical aberration.

name: OffAxisParabolicMirror
teaser: Off-axis parabolic mirror for achromatic focusing.

name: EllipsoidalMirror
teaser: Concave ellipsoid that images one focus into the other.

name: OffAxisEllipsoidalMirror
teaser: Off-axis ellipsoid segment separating in- and outgoing beam.

name: HyperbolicMirror
teaser: Convex hyperboloid, e.g. the secondary of a Cassegrain telescope.

name: OffAxisHyperbolicMirror
teaser: Off-axis hyperboloid segment for folded two-mirror systems.

name: Retroreflector
teaser: Corner-cube reflector that returns rays toward their source.

name: Lens
teaser: Generic refractive lens built from any pair of surfaces.

name: DoubletLens
teaser: Cemented two-element lens for reduced chromatic aberration.

name: ThinLens
teaser: Idealized thin spherical lens.

name: SphericalLens
teaser: Spherical singlet lens built from manufacturer data.

name: SphericalDoubletLens
teaser: Convenience constructor for spherical doublet lenses.

name: TripletLens
teaser: Three cemented elements sharing two common surfaces.

name: SphericalTripletLens
teaser: Cemented triplet from four radii and one diameter.

name: Prism
teaser: Generic refractive prism built from any closed shape.

name: RightAnglePrism
teaser: Right-angle symmetric prism, e.g. for cube beamsplitters.

name: ThinBeamsplitter
teaser: Zero-thickness rectangular splitting coating.

name: RoundThinBeamsplitter
teaser: Zero-thickness round splitting coating.

name: RectangularPlateBeamsplitter
teaser: Rectangular plate beamsplitter with a finite substrate.

name: RoundPlateBeamsplitter
teaser: Round plate beamsplitter with a finite substrate.

name: CubeBeamsplitter
teaser: Two cemented right-angle prisms forming a cube splitter.

name: RectangularCompensatorPlate
teaser: Corrects the parallel beam offset of a plate beamsplitter.

name: Detector
teaser: Detection screen for field, spot and power analysis.

name: PolarizationFilter
teaser: Ideal zero-thickness linear polarization filter.

name: RoundPolarizationFilter
teaser: Round zero-thickness linear polarization filter.

name: LinearPolarizer
teaser: Polarizing film laminated between two glass plates.

name: RoundLinearPolarizer
teaser: Builds a round film polarizer with glass substrates.

name: MeshDummy
teaser: Non-interacting mesh loaded from a file, e.g. a mount.

name: NonInteractableObject
teaser: Shape that is rendered but ignored by the ray tracer.

name: IntersectableObject
teaser: Passive shape that blocks the beam path like a hard target.
